artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a person facing forward with a slightly turned head to the right. The person has a composed expression with finely structured facial features, including narrow eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth. The hair is styled intricately, with a large, tall headpiece adorned with a feather and ornate decoration. The person's attire is opulent, featuring an embellished high-neck collar and richly patterned fabric. Strings of pearls and various decorative elements are seen around the neck and shoulders. The background of the image is plain.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person's bust. The figure is centered, looking straight ahead with a calm expression. They have short, curly hair, a halo, and wear a plain garment with a decorative neckline. The engraving is set on aged paper, framed by parallel lines. The text at the bottom reads "SVLCIA VERGINE ET MAR" along with "1599." There are no visible objects or jewelry, and the background is plain, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body and head of a man in profile. He is facing to the right, with his head turned to display his facial features. He has a long beard and slightly curly hair. His facial features include a prominent nose and a visible ear. He is wearing a loose garment that drapes over his shoulders. The background is plain, with light discoloration and spots on the paper likely due to age.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile view, with a bald head, curly beard, and prominent facial features. He is wearing a draped garment and is depicted on a textured backdrop on a slightly yellowed sheet of paper with brown spots.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of an elderly man, showing the upper portion of his body with his head and part of his shoulders visible. The man is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. He has a large, full beard, curly shoulder-length hair, a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. He is wearing a draped cloth over his shoulders. The engraving is set on a plain background within a rectangular section of the page, with some handwritten text at the bottom left.

artworks.title: Saint Francis of Assisi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man in a three-quarter view, with his arms crossed over his chest. He has a contemplative expression, looking upward to his right. The man has a pronounced brow, a full beard, and curly hair. He wears a robe with large folds and a halo behind his head. The background features a simple, lined pattern implying divine illumination. The image is an engraving on textured paper.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a man's head, capturing his face and part of his neck. His head is positioned in a three-quarter view, tilted slightly back, with his mouth wide open. He has curly, voluminous hair that flows around his head, with intricate detail showing texture and movement. His facial features are defined, with furrowed brows and a prominent nose. No clothing is visible. The background is plain. The image is on a lightly discolored, textured page.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows four hands engaged in different actions. One hand holds a quill pen, another points towards a text labeled "Linea Circularis," the third hand holds a rectangular object, and the fourth hand grips a small stick or stylus. Each hand is dressed in a sleeve with a ruffled cuff. The background is plain with a delicate border surrounding the illustration.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This is an artwork showing six hands in different positions and gestures. The hands are detailed, showcasing their anatomy and texture. The style appears to be classical with careful shading for a three-dimensional effect. The background is plain to keep the focus on the hands. The depiction suggests a focus on anatomical drawing.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of hands engaged in different tasks with tools. The drawing presents a study of three pairs of hands, each performing a different action involving tools or implements. The top pair of hands is holding a small knife while the other hand holds an object that seems to be carved or cut. In the middle, one hand is pulling a rope or string over an edge being gripped by the other hand. In the bottom pair, one hand is turning a cylindrical object, while the other seems to stabilize or guide it. The detailed rendering showcases the skillful depiction of hand anatomy and the implied motion of crafting or manipulating objects, focusing on the texture and shading to convey depth and realism. The composition might serve as a study or academic drawing to explore the dynamic poses of hands.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple hands positioned around a keyboard instrument. The drawing depicts various hand gestures and positions, with fingers spread and overlapping over the keys. Each hand appears to have a slightly different gesture. The hands are drawn with attention to anatomical detail, capturing the natural lines and contours of each digit and knuckle. The drawing is oriented vertically, with the keyboard set at an angle that suggests depth and perspective. The artwork is a study of form and motion, rendering the hands with a sense of realism and subtle shading.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various forearms and hands. The composition consists of several studies of forearms and hands, arranged creatively on the page. The largest element is a muscular forearm and hand positioned vertically. Above it is another hand holding a pair of drawing tools. To the left, multiple smaller studies of arms and hands are shown in different poses, each distinct in the portrayal of muscles and skin texture. The use of line and hatching creates a sense of depth and volume throughout the piece.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed engraving of various human feet from different angles and perspectives. Only feet are depicted, with no other body parts visible. The feet are shown in different positions such as standing firmly, positioned sideways, and from a top-down view. No facial features or hair are visible. There are no clothing, jewelry, or objects depicted. The background is a plain textured surface within the frame of the engraving, and the aged edges of the paper are visible.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of detailed studies of various feet. The drawing consists of several anatomical studies, focusing on the intricate structures and forms of feet. Each foot is rendered with fine detail, highlighting the textures and contours of the skin, muscles, and bones. The use of line work and shading provides a sense of depth and three-dimensionality to the forms. The feet are presented from different angles and positions, showcasing a range of natural poses and anatomical exploration. The overall composition is dedicated to capturing the realism and subtle intricacies of the human feet.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various studies of feet. The illustration shows sketches of feet from different angles and postures. The feet are intricately detailed with defined contours and shading to depict musculature and structure. The image uses cross-hatching and line work for depth and form. Each foot study is shown in a confined space, possibly for comparison or anatomical study. The artwork appears on aged paper, adding to the classical and academic feel of the study.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows an anatomical study of the lower body, focusing on the legs. The illustration displays detailed musculature and posture of the legs from mid-thigh to the feet. The legs are depicted in a standing stance; the left leg is slightly bent with the foot flat on the ground, while the right leg is extended with the toes pointing downwards. There are no facial features or hair depicted. The sketch emphasizes the anatomical structure and musculature of the legs, devoid of clothing. Annotations in the form of small lines and letters indicate specific parts of the leg muscles. The background is plain, and the image is presented on a page resembling an antique or classical anatomy book.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image features a detailed anatomical drawing of the lower body, focusing on the entire right leg and foot from the side. The drawing shows detailed musculature and anatomical structure, with lines and shading highlighting the muscles. An inset illustration of a knee joint is visible in the background on the left side. The drawing excludes facial features, hair, clothing, or jewelry. The background is a plain, beige-colored surface with stains and discoloration.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The sketch depicts the muscular upper torso of a person, emphasizing the midriff, chest, and arms. The head and lower body are not visible. The figure is shown in a slightly twisted posture, with both arms bent, showcasing muscular definition and anatomical details. The illustration is set against a plain background. An intricate face or mask is depicted near the lower right corner. The paper shows signs of age with visible stains and discoloration. No objects or jewelry are present in the visible area of the artwork.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a person's back, captured from the waist up. The person faces away from the viewer with arms raised and bent at the elbows, hands pointing forward. The back of their head, featuring short, curly hair, is visible. The person is unclothed, displaying a muscular back. The background consists of cloud-like formations framing the scene. The setting is enclosed within a rectangular frame on an aged, textured background.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular person from the back seated with legs bent and hands resting on the ground. The person's head is turned towards the left and tilted upward. The background is plain with a textured appearance, similar to aged paper, framing the core illustration.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows two male figures from the waist up in an artistic rendering. One figure faces forward with a slightly turned head, and the other is in profile facing to the right. Both figures have defined muscles, short, curly hair, and are draped with a cloth over their lower bodies. The background is plain with subtle shading. The image is presented on textured, aged paper with visible stains and discoloration along the edges.

artworks.title: Print from Drawing Book
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a warrior in armor. The warrior is sitting on a cloud, wearing detailed armor, a helmet with a crest, holding a shield and a spear. The sketch is rendered with fine lines and shading to depict the warrior's muscular structure and clothing folds. The paper has a textured appearance, giving the artwork character.

artworks.title: A Pleasure House
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Joos van Winghe
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate at bottom): 38.6 × 48.2 cm (15 3/16 × 19 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: Numerous figures are depicted in a lavish indoor setting. A woman in an intricate gown appears to be dancing, surrounded by other individuals engaged in various activities. The facial features and hairstyles are finely detailed, with ornate hairstyles typical of the period. The clothing is elaborate, featuring dresses, tunics, and capes. Many figures are holding objects, such as musical instruments, goblets, and candles. The background features architectural elements, including statues, pillars, niches, and a large, sculpted figure in an alcove.

artworks.title: Camera sepolcrale
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image portrays an architectural ruin from a slightly elevated vantage point filled with classical architecture and overgrown foliage. The horizon is obscured by towering walls and arches. The etching technique shows precise line work for textures of stone and vegetation with cross-hatching for shadows. The monochrome palette emphasizes the depth of the scene. Closest are broken statues and vegetation. Figures are seen amidst the ruins, with light filtering through the arches in the distance.
